classification: Additive opt-in coverage readiness and sampled SLO; local acceptance only
receiptImpact: Adds a separate Insight Coverage v1 EIP-712 domain, immutable content-addressed policy, source observations, offline verification and optional exact-call context commitments. Existing OracleSafetyCheck and ExecutionReceipt layouts, source-group mapping, verdict rules, keys and historical bytes are unchanged. New coverage uses a dedicated consumer-pinned signer and explicit SDK opt-in. SLO statistics are unsigned operational measurements, never permission to execute.
activationRule: No partner policy or activation mapping changes. New runtime coverage requires consumer opt-in and independently pinned policy and key validity. No local fixture establishes partner acceptance, production adoption or SLA compliance.
